heroSubheading: How we handle and protect your personal information when you browse our Disneyland Paris Tickets guide.

sections.heading: 1. Who We Are & Independent Portal Disclaimer
sections.body:
This website is an independent travel portal and ticket guide dedicated to providing accurate visitor information, ticket price comparisons, and planning tips for Disneyland Paris.

Trademark Notice: This website is independently operated and is not affiliated with, authorized by, sponsored by, or endorsed by Euro Disney S.C.A., The Walt Disney Company, or any of their subsidiaries. All trademarks, service marks, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
sections.body:
We do not collect or store sensitive personal payment details or credit card information directly on our servers. When you navigate our website, we may gather:

  • Anonymized Analytics Data: Page views, browser type, operating system, and general referrer URLs.
  • Contact Form Inquiries: Any email address or message content voluntarily submitted through our customer support form.

sections.heading: 3. Cookies & Analytical Metrics
sections.body: We utilize standard performance cookies and analytics services to understand visitor traffic patterns and optimize loading speeds. You can disable or modify cookie permissions via your browser settings at any time without restricting page access.

sections.heading: 4. Third-Party Referral Links
sections.body: When clicking booking links to purchase e-tickets, you are securely transferred to authorized primary ticket distributors (including GetYourGuide). Checkout security, payment processing, and e-ticket voucher delivery are managed directly by these GDPR-compliant partners.

sections.heading: 5. Contact Information
sections.body: For questions concerning this Privacy Policy, please email our support team at livetravelpartner@gmail.com.
